posts.title: MODMOR Expands Supply to Northern Province

Contact our branch teams to learn more.

posts.title: Understanding ZPPA Registration for Suppliers
posts.author: MODMOR Compliance Team
posts.excerpt: A quick guide for businesses looking to register with the Zambia Public Procurement Authority.
posts.content:
What is ZPPA?

The Zambia Public Procurement Authority (ZPPA) regulates all public procurement in the country.

Why Register?

Being ZPPA-registered opens doors to government tenders and public sector contracts.

  • Access to public sector contracts
  • Enhanced credibility
  • Formal compliance status

MODMOR's Experience

We've been ZPPA-certified and supply to public institutions under multiple registered categories.
